# Live Life Healthcare Lab

> CMC-certified 24/7 diagnostic and pathology laboratory in Udumalaipettai, Tamil Nadu. Free home blood sample collection and fully automated testing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, packages and 24/7 contact options.
- [About](/about): Lab story, director, equipment and CMC certification.
- [Tests & Packages](/tests): Full price list of tests and curated health packages.
- [Book Appointment](/appointments): Walk-in or free home collection booking.
- [FAQ](/faq): Hours, home collection, fasting, results, accreditation.
- [Contact](/contact): Phone numbers, address and directions.
